title: Circuit and CNF satisfiability
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit. Suppose every gate of $C$ has at most two input vertices. Then $C$ has an input assignment for which its output is true if and only if the CNF formula associated with $C$ has a satisfying assignment.
